summary: Federal investigators link ransom negotiators to the ShinyHunters extortion site behind $70M in theft while DHS orders civilian agencies to purge DeepSeek; supply-chain pressure mounts as Updraft keys push backdoors to WordPress sites and UNC7017 trojanized AOMEI updates, and ransomware crews pile onto PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257 as ConnectWise tenant exposure widens.
